title: Demonic Canvas
description: A large painting of a monstrous pink demon with horns, sharp claws and dripping black voids stands propped in a derelict warehouse. The surrounding floor is covered in melted pink wax from numerous lit candles, shattered picture frames, and splatters of pink paint under dim hanging lights.
prompt: A large ominous painting of a terrifying pink demon with horns, gaping maw and long clawed hands reaching forward, black voids dripping from its body, the canvas stands in the center of a dark abandoned industrial warehouse with brick walls covered in pink graffiti, dozens of lit pink candles melted on the dirty floor, broken frames and pink paint splatters everywhere, single hanging pink bulb providing dim light, eerie and sinister atmosphere, cinematic lighting
